title: Cyber-Zero: Training Cybersecurity Agents without Runtime
abstract: arXiv:2508.00910v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in software engineering tasks when trained with executable runtime environments, particularly in resolving GitHub issues. However, such runtime environments are often unavailable in other domains, especially cybersecurity, where challenge configurations and execution contexts are ephemeral or restricted. We present Cyber-Zero, the first runtime-free framework for synthesizing high-quality agent trajectories to train cybersecurity LLMs. Cyber-Zero leverages publicly available CTF writeups and employs persona-driven LLM simulation to reverse-engineer runtime behaviors and generate realistic, long-horizon interaction sequences without actual environments. Using trajectories synthesized by Cyber-Zero, we train LLM-based agents that achieve up to 11.4% absolute performance gains over baseline models on three prominent CTF benchmarks: InterCode-CTF, NYU CTF Bench, and Cybe

translated_title: Cyber-Zero：无需运行时环境训练网络安全智能体
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）在软件工程任务中通过可执行运行时环境的训练已取得显著成功，尤其是在解决GitHub问题方面。然而，此类运行时环境在其他领域往往不可用，特别是在网络安全领域，挑战配置和执行环境通常是短暂的或受限的。我们提出了Cyber-Zero，这是首个无需运行时环境的框架，用于合成高质量的智能体轨迹以训练网络安全LLM。Cyber-Zero利用公开可用的CTF（夺旗赛）解题报告，并采用基于角色扮演的LLM模拟来逆向工程运行时行为，在无需实际环境的情况下生成逼真的、长时程的交互序列。使用Cyber-Zero合成的轨迹训练的LLM智能体，在三个知名CTF基准测试上相比基线模型取得了最高11.4%的绝对性能提升。
tldr: Cyber-Zero是首个无需运行时环境的网络安全智能体训练框架，通过利用公开CTF解题报告和基于角色扮演的LLM模拟来合成高质量交互轨迹，使训练出的智能体在三个CTF基准测试上相比基线模型最高取得11.4%的绝对性能提升。
en_tdlr: Cyber-Zero is the first runtime-free framework for training cybersecurity LLM agents, which synthesizes high-quality interaction trajectories from public CTF writeups via persona-driven LLM simulation, achieving up to 11.4% absolute performance gains over baselines on three CTF benchmarks.
